title: Corelib harness performance (engine reuse, sub-5min matrix)
body:
The production gate is one `beskid test --all-targets --plain` invocation over 61 manifest entries. Current-tip evidence uses deterministic EOF and observes no target hang. A hard-capped five-minute shared process reached 43 target starts; a bounded tail replay completed coverage at 38 passing / 23 failing. Repeated dependency materialization, normalization, and typechecking remain visible for each target, so one-session state reuse and the sub-five-minute acceptance are not proven. The split replay is diagnostic coverage, not release evidence.

## Acceptance

- Fresh functional matrix is 61/61
- One EOF-bound `--all-targets` run completes under **5 minutes**
- Simple assertion targets complete under **200ms**
- Per-target timeout, phase attribution, and clean cancellation are retained

## Blocked on

Functional `corelib-matrix-green` exit (61/61).

**Research:** `docs/superpowers/reports/2026-08-11-cyb-188-corelib-closure-graph.md` on `research/0-4-corelib-failure-graph` at `04bf6b77`.

**Linear:** [CYB-181](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-181/v04-recover-authoritative-61-target-corelib-matrix-and-bounded-harness)
